scope: Retained install_only originals whose assets and every discovered Mach-O member match the current structural formal-lock; not installed-app or final-seal evidence.

method.symbolRules: Undefined external: (n_type & 0x0e) == 0 and (n_type & 1) == 1; high byte of n_desc is library ordinal. Ordinal 254 is dynamic lookup, not a resolved dependency. Signals are lexical candidates, not proof of source ownership.
limitations: No execution on Mac, dyld shared-cache expansion, dlopen trace, disassembly, or complete static-code attribution.
No provider/add-on or complete final application audit.
Tix negative observations are bounded evidence, not whole-product absence approval.
X-prefixed definitions in Tk are not equated to libX11 provenance.

# Tcl package index file, version 1.1
# This file is generated by the "pkg_mkIndex -direct" command
# and sourced either when an application starts up or
# by a "package unknown" script.  It invokes the
# "package ifneeded" command to set up package-related
# information so that packages will be loaded automatically
# in response to "package require" commands.  When this
# script is sourced, the variable $dir must contain the
# full path name of this file's directory.

if {![package vsatisfies [package provide Tcl] 8.6-]} {return}
package ifneeded opt 0.4.10 [list source -encoding utf-8 [file join $dir optparse.tcl]]

if {![package vsatisfies [package provide Tcl] 9.0]} return
    package ifneeded tk 9.0.4 [list load [file normalize [file join $dir .. libtcl9tk9.0.dylib]]]
package ifneeded Tk 9.0.4 [list package require -exact tk 9.0.4]
